What legal forms are used by entities whose legal name starts with 'BLACKROCK GLOBAL'? Give the distinct legal form names.
items.sparql:
PREFIX gleif-L1: <https://www.gleif.org/ontology/L1/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?legalFormLabel WHERE {
  ?entity gleif-L1:hasLegalName ?name .
  FILTER regex(?name, "^BLACKROCK GLOBAL", "i") .
  ?entity gleif-L1:hasLegalForm ?lf .
  ?lf rdfs:label ?legalFormLabel .
}

}
